hypothesis: Signed-model responses depend on label-related coordinate sign patterns beyond fixed recipient magnitudes.
alternative: T02 benefit reflects optimization or joint representation adaptation, without consistent label-related sign response.
intervention: For recipient i replace u_i by abs(u_i)*sign(u_j), sign(0)=+1. Preserve z_i, every coordinate magnitude, norm, model and head. All 31 same-label other videos and all 32 opposite-label videos in same domain; average within recipient first.
control: Abs checkpoint repeats identical intervention followed by abs; maximum logit change must be <1e-4. Baseline checkpoint replay logits error <1e-4. Norm error <1e-5.
criterion: J=mean_recipient(mean_opposite_CE - mean_same_CE); supports if macro J>=0.02 nat and every domain J>0. Otherwise not supported by criterion. No threshold tuning.
scope: Fixed 192 recipient videos, one frame per video; donor pairs dependent. Zero updates; 2 fixed T02 checkpoints; no seed variation. Reused development data, not new final test.
stops: norm preservation or abs negative-control failure
dedup: P03-D02 replaced whole residual and mixed amplitude/direction. This isolates coordinate signs at fixed magnitudes on newly trained N01-T02 weights; 4090 N05 compares amplitude representation training and does not do sign-only donors.
limitation: Donor labels are used for diagnostic conditioning only, not deployed inference. Off-manifold sign/amplitude combinations and joint learned representation confound generalization. Response sensitivity only, not causal mediation or retraining benefit.
